name: Travelers
description: Travelers is a property and casualty insurer: customers pay premiums ($43.9B earned in 2025), Travelers pays claims later, and it invests the float (net investment income $3.96B) before any claim is paid. Business Insurance (commercial property, liability, workers' compensation, through independent agents) is 53 percent of revenue, Personal Insurance (auto and homeowners) 37 percent and Bond & Specialty (surety and management liability) 9 percent. Profit depends on the combined ratio (claims plus costs as a share of premium; 89.9 percent in 2025, 92.5 percent in 2024) and on catastrophe weather losses, not on a spread.

employees.note: Approximately 34,000 employees, about 90 percent in the United States (10-K).

businessLines.name: Business Insurance
businessLines.how: Businesses pay premiums (mostly through independent agents and brokers) for workers' compensation, commercial property, general liability, commercial multi-peril, commercial auto and other cover; Travelers keeps the premium less claims and costs, and earns investment income on the reserves it holds. Net written premiums: Middle Market 12.54B, Select Accounts 3.83B, National Property and Other 3.11B, International 1.93B, National Accounts 1.26B.

businessLines.name: Bond & Specialty Insurance
businessLines.how: Customers pay premiums for surety bonds (a guarantee that a contractor or other party will perform), fidelity, management liability and professional liability cover; segment income 950 on revenue 4,579 (20.7 percent, computed). Net written premiums: Domestic 3.68B, International 0.58B.

businessLines.name: Personal Insurance
businessLines.how: Households pay premiums for auto and homeowners insurance, marketed mainly through thousands of independent agents and brokers. Net written premiums 17.45B: Homeowners and Other 9.05B (51.9 percent), automobile 7.75B (computed), International 0.65B; segment income rose 64 percent in 2025 (2,053 vs 1,249).

businessLines.name: Other / eliminations
businessLines.how: Residual between segment revenue (48,876) and consolidated revenue (48,828); corporate and other items.
